def settle(objs, n=22, rounds=100):
 # tuples y,x,direction,tag; direction -1 for 8 +1 for2
 objs=[list(o) for o in objs]
 for _ in range(rounds):
  changed=False
  order=sorted(range(len(objs)), key=lambda i: (objs[i][2]*objs[i][1])) # left dir -1 sorts descending? -x ascending = x descending wrong
  # custom process all left by x asc, right by x desc
  order=sorted([i for i,o in enumerate(objs) if o[2]==-1],key=lambda i:objs[i][1])+sorted([i for i,o in enumerate(objs) if o[2]==1],key=lambda i:-objs[i][1])
  for i in order:
   y,x,d,tag=objs[i]
   nx=x+d
   if not 0<=nx<=n-5:continue
   clear=True
   for j,(yy,xx,dd,t) in enumerate(objs):
    if i==j:continue
    if max(y,yy)<min(y+5,yy+5) and max(nx,xx)<min(nx+5,xx+5):clear=False;break
   if clear:objs[i][1]=nx;changed=True
  if not changed:break
 return [(o[0],o[1],o[3]) for o in objs]
